title: Brain Structure: Hindbrain, Midbrain, Forebrain, Limbic System
summary: Brain divisions from anterior to posterior; five swellings; myelencephalon, metencephalon, midbrain, forebrain; limbic system structures.
objectives: List brain divisions from anterior to posterior.
Identify the five brain swellings and adult derivatives.
Describe limbic system structures and functions.
revision: Brain divisions: hindbrain → midbrain → forebrain. Five swellings become adult structures. Limbic system = hippocampus, amygdala, hypothalamus, cingulate gyrus (emotion, memory, motivation).
traps: Five swellings: telencephalon, diencephalon, mesencephalon, metencephalon, myelencephalon.

notes.c: Brain divisions from anterior to posterior

notes.t: The limbic system is a group of structures involved in emotion, memory and motivation. Key structures: hippocampus, amygdala, hypothalamus, cingulate gyrus.
Five brain swellings and their adult derivatives are frequently tested. Limbic system structures and their functions (emotion, memory) are key UGC NET topics.

mnemonics.title: TDM MM
mnemonics.text: T — Telencephalon (cerebral hemispheres), D — Diencephalon (thalamus/hypothalamus), M — Mesencephalon (midbrain), M — Metencephalon (pons/cerebellum), M — Myelencephalon (medulla)
